verifierBody:
pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ c59595c488f2695d2514530f1ec0b4b9c91587e6

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff implements mid-message slash tokens, longest-match span detection, a pill in the composer and in user bubbles, and keeps the sent text as plain /name; the head build compiles and the existing skill-list journey still passes. However, no journey actually shows a pill or a mid-message insertion, so the headline outcome is unverified.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed
- `session-reader.md` parent: not passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- native-skills.md passed on both parent and head with the same 16 steps (slash list, filter, insert, plus menu, draft preserved), so there is no regression but also no head-only outcome.
- Head native-receipts.txt shows the bot received /review-native investigation and /qa:verify-native draft stays, i.e. leading skills still send as plain /name text.
- session-reader.md passed on head (VERIFY_SENT_528, VERIFY_ENTER_528, VERIFY_INTERRUPTED_528), showing the new composer widget still types, sends and interrupts.
- The session-reader parent run failed only with 'BLOCKED: emulator cannot reach 10.0.2.2', an environment failure, not old behaviour, so that comparison shows nothing.
- No artifact step, receipt or text file in either run names or asserts a pill; the 16 screenshots cannot be inspected, so the pill rendering is not shown by any evidence.
- The new unit tests (NativeSkillsTest slashWordMatchesOnlyAKnownSkill, DesignKitTest skillPillUsesTheSurfaceAndOutline) are in the diff but were not run per the description and are not compiled by the APK/instrumentation builds.

Not covered:
- The draft composer showing the skill as a dark pill with a thin outline (and neighbouring words staying put).
- The sent chat bubble showing the same pill.
- Picking a skill for a slash word in the middle of a message and having only that slash word replaced (the journey inserts at the start of the draft).
- The negative cases on device: /home/x, a/b, http://x/y and ./run not becoming pills.
- Whether the composer pills align with the text (drawn from the text layout onto a separate overlay) and whether they survive a scrolling multi-line draft.

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43766968965
